**⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️** *Wonderful experience*

I would like to thank Dr. Saskia for the exceptional care given to my cat Betty. Dr. was professional, kind, and truly attentive — explaining everything clearly and making us feel at ease throughout the consultation. It is rare to find a veterinarian who combines such expertise with genuine warmth and care for the animal. I highly recommend Dr.Saskia to any pet owner looking for outstanding veterinary care.

— Adriana Agostini

Called Saskia this morning. Our Chaya had to be put to sleep today 😭. Time was short and few doctors had time to come to the house.

Saskia was our savior.

Saskia is compassionate, skilled, and takes the time to explain everything. During the process, she also told us what the next step was. We were able to say goodbye in peace.
Incredibly grateful !!! 💕

We recently had to say goodbye to our 20-year-old ginger cat. He deteriorated so rapidly on Friday evening that we decided on Saturday morning that the time had come. Fortunately, we found Cira willing to come to us on Saturday afternoon so …
Saskia was great and exceeded my expectations. Definitely my new homevet, very amicable and professional!
